description: Code-compatible FlockLab Sky/TelosB July 2019 wireless link-quality network; all edges are dynamic, p_on derived from official CSV PRR.

determination_rules.topology: One directed wireless link is included iff the official CSV shows strictly positive mean packet reception for that sender/receiver pair over July 2019.
determination_rules.edge_capacity: Set to 1.0 as a normalized per-slot successful-service unit; the empirical wireless behavior is represented by p_on.
determination_rules.dynamic_links: All included directed links are dynamic because the benchmark is a time-varying wireless link-quality dataset.
determination_rules.p_on: Empirical mean packet reception ratio = mean(rcv_total/100) over all tests for the sender/receiver pair.
determination_rules.node_capacity: The benchmark has no edge-compute capacity field. To fit the uploaded simulator schema, all nodes are given the same normalized compute capacity 1.0 because the selected official dataset uses a single homogeneous platform (Sky/TelosB).

caveats: The node capacities are a normalized overlay assumption required by the simulator, not a measured benchmark quantity.
The FlockLab benchmark natively describes wireless link quality, not edge-compute capacities.
metadata.simulator_capacity_overlay: homogeneous normalized capacities; not official compute/throughput data
metadata.node_capacity_rule: all nodes capacity=1.0 because FlockLab dataset has homogeneous embedded nodes and no edge-compute capacity field
metadata.edge_capacity_rule: all edges capacity=1.0 normalized service unit; packet reception reliability encoded by p_on
metadata.dynamic_edge_rule: all measured directed edges with monthly mean PRR > 0 are dynamic
